title: Intuit to Acquire HR Platform GoCo
reviewed_scope_evidence: The deal is expected to close in Q4 FY25.
assessment: GoCo announced before FY2025Q3 results. Do not assume completion or zero revenue contribution; verify whether the new full-year guide includes the expected Q4 transaction.

title: Intuit to Acquire Financial Health Startup SeedFi
reviewed_scope_evidence: The transaction is not expected to have a material impact on Intuit’s operating results for the full fiscal year 2023.
assessment: SeedFi issuer explicitly anticipates immaterial FY2023 operating impact; do not equate this with exactly zero total-revenue contribution. Closing and quantitative relevance remain to verify.

title: Intuit to Acquire Technology from Zendrive
reviewed_scope_evidence: Intuit expects to close the transaction in Q4 FY24.
Terms of the deal weren't disclosed.
assessment: Zendrive transaction described as technology and certain employees, not an assertion that all Zendrive revenue transfers. Do not mechanically treat it as full-company consolidation.
